REViewer 0.2.7 – the program of the module REViewer/0.2.7

Licence: GNU GPL 3 or later (notices/REViewer-LICENSE.txt, notices/REViewer-COPYRIGHT.txt); the graph-tools library of
the release: Apache 2.0. Compiled in, each with its notice in notices/: Boost 1.73.0 (its program_options library and
headers; Boost Software License), HTSlib 1.10.2 (MIT/Expat and modified BSD), spdlog 1.6.1 with its fmt (MIT), zlib
1.3.1, bzip2 1.0.8, liblzma of XZ 5.4.6, and Emscripten's runtime (MIT and NCSA).

Upstream source: https://github.com/Illumina/REViewer, tag v0.2.7 (GitHub's archive, REViewer-v0.2.7.tar.gz, SHA-256
8411c40028907b0294b1899cd20af6934325796da160511b649044ecf9a5169f); the archives of the libraries, their addresses and
SHA-256: ../../../licenses/genomics-wasm-build/tools/reviewer/versions.lock.json. The source of REViewer and of every
library compiled into it is in ../../../licenses/sources/ – Boost in three parts (its README says how to join them) –
with the build recipe in ../../../licenses/genomics-wasm-build/ (scripts/build-reviewer.py, tools/reviewer/).

Compiled to WebAssembly by the genomics-wasm project (https://github.com/comparativechrono/genomics-wasm, commit
d9b9f7d of 22 October 2026, pull request 9) with Emscripten 3.1.64: one thread, at most 2 GiB of memory, local files
only, C++ exceptions as upstream. One change (tools/reviewer/: README.md, linux-rand.hh; applied by
scripts/build-reviewer.py): REViewer assigns the reads that could come from either allele with the C library's rand(),
never seeded; Emscripten's C library gives another sequence than GNU libc's, which would change the read assignments,
allele depths and plots. That one call uses a copy of GNU libc's default sequence (checked against it for 100,000
values), so the results are those of REViewer on Linux.

The files here are those of dist/reviewer/ in the project's tested release package repeats-wasm.zip (SHA-256
ba35c0a07342cba18cc2b844f728373dbe2c33feed7c4ff784a897292acf31d9), made by its workflow "Build and validate repeat
analysis" (.github/workflows/repeats.yml, run 39692680602), unchanged: reviewer.mjs and .wasm, build-manifest.json
(the compiler, the build's inputs and the SHA-256 of every file) and notices/. Left out: the package's copies of the
source archives (the same files are in ../../../licenses/sources/), its runner, tests and test data (its example data
are in /gel_data_resources/example_scripts/workshop_scripts/repeat_expansions/).

Checked by the project against the programs built natively from the same sources, unchanged and with the port's
changes: 15 of 15 cases, the same results in Node.js, Chromium, Firefox and WebKit – ExpansionHunter's own example (an
SNV next to a CAG repeat: seeking and streaming, both aligners, from BAM and from CRAM), synthetic normal, expanded
and X-chromosome repeats (male and female), an SNV or a second repeat next to a repeat, ExpansionHunter → samtools
sort and index → REViewer for every repeat locus, REViewer's own BEAN1 example, an empty BAM file, and the errors of a
missing index, a contig not in the reference and a locus not in the catalog. Compared exactly – genotypes, intervals,
read counts, allele depths, every field of the BAMlets, the geometry and labels of the plots; only representation set
aside (the order of JSON keys and of VCF and SVG attributes, BAM compression). And the package itself, unzipped, in
all four. REViewer's plot of its BEAN1 example here is byte for byte the one REViewer 0.2.7 draws on Linux with the
full chromosome 16 (SHA-256 0d3c4d9c…, as datasets/repeats/README.md records it).

In the terminal: REViewer runs this program (assets/js/repeats-re.js), each command in a worker of its own
(assets/js/threads-worker.mjs) with the files its arguments name and their indexes. It needs the BAMlet of
ExpansionHunter sorted and indexed (samtools sort, samtools index), the VCF, the reference and the catalog of the same
ExpansionHunter run, and writes PREFIX.LOCUS.svg (open it with  firefox PREFIX.LOCUS.svg  or from the file manager),
PREFIX.metrics.tsv and PREFIX.phasing.tsv. REViewer 0.2.7 cannot draw a locus whose catalog entry has a small variant
next to the repeat (upstream's limitation).
